description: This file defines a template utility for compile-time loop unrolling using recursion and template specialization. It provides the 'ForcedUnroll' class template that, when instantiated with a compile-time integer, calls a provided function sequentially for each index from 0 up to n-1.

classes.name: ForcedUnroll
classes.description: A template struct that performs compile-time unrolling of loops by recursively calling itself, and invoking a provided function with index constants.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the provided function 'f' with sequential compile-time index constants starting from 0 up to n-1, passing any additional arguments to each invocation.

methods.name: C10_ALWAYS_INLINE void operator ()(const Func & f,Args...args) const

ctags.name: operator ()
ctags.pattern: /^  C10_ALWAYS_INLINE void operator()(const Func& f, Args... args) const {$/
